validate.doorRect: {name}: a door must be a rectangle

mapError.noSwitch: Object #{n} is linked to the {color} switch, but the map has no {color} switch or event zone.
mapError.portalAlone: Portal #{n} has no other {color} portal to lead to.
mapError.portalNoExit: Portal #{n} has no {color} portal it can exit from (the others are entrance-only).
mapWarn.aspect: This map is not 16:9, so it is shown with bars around it.
mapWarn.startOutside: The START area extends outside the map.
mapWarn.goalOutside: The GOAL area extends outside the map.
mapWarn.wallOnStart: Wall #{n} overlaps START when the run begins.
mapWarn.noMarkers: Object #{n} is set to move but has no markers.
mapWarn.starOrder: Star times should get longer from 3 stars to 1 star.
mapWarn.coinInGoal: Coin #{n} is inside GOAL; it is collected on the way in.
mapWarn.boulderNoRoute: Boulder #{n} has no route, so it won't roll.
mapWarn.linkStartStill: Object #{n} is set to start moving on a switch, but it doesn't move or rotate.
mapWarn.linkStopStill: Object #{n} is set to stop moving on a switch, but it doesn't move or rotate.

sd.clickAnElementOnThe: Click an element on the stage to edit it. Drag to move, drag the blue corner to resize (Alt = no snapping).
sd.onlyWhenEveryLevelIs: Only when every level is cleared
pack.startANewEmptyMap: Start a new, empty map pack? The current pack is removed from this browser (export it first to keep it).
pack.replaceTheOpenLevelWith: Replace the open level with the map in the editor
pack.setEachLevelNumberTo: Set each level number to its position in the pack
pack.downloadThePackAsA: Download the pack as a .pack.json file
pack.full: A pack can hold at most {max} levels
pack.confirmReplace: Replace the current pack with "{name}" ({n} levels)?
pack.linkCopied: Pack link copied to clipboard ({n} chars)
pack.linkManual: Pack link created — please copy it manually ({n} chars)
pack.unverified: Not cleared yet: open it and test play, or play the pack
pack.statusEmpty: Empty pack. Build a level, then "Add current map". Levels are played in this order.
pack.statusDirty: Level {n} has unsaved edits — "Save to pack" to keep them.
pack.statusUnverifiedOne: {n} level · {unverified} not cleared yet (sharing needs every level cleared).
pack.statusUnverifiedMany: {n} levels · {unverified} not cleared yet (sharing needs every level cleared).
pack.statusReadyOne: {n} level · all cleared, ready to share.

ed.clearTheCurrentMapAnd: Clear the current map and start a new one? (You can restore it with Undo)
ed.theseShapesCouldNotBe: These shapes could not be merged
ed.pickAToolFromThe: Pick a tool from the palette, or select an object with the Select tool (V). Drag on empty space to select several.
ed.nothingCanHurtTheCursor: Nothing can hurt the cursor in here: walls, obstacles, saws and lasers passing through are harmless, and it counts as floor.
ed.tiltNote: Turns around the object's center, clockwise. Drag the round handle above the selection (15° steps with Snap or Shift, Alt for free).
ed.mapThemeNote: Played on its own (share link), the map wears this theme's badge, music and maze colors. Inside a theme pack, the pack's settings apply instead.
ed.0PointsRight90Down: 0° points right, 90° down. Drag the arc ends to change the angles, the arc middle for the radius.
ed.laserBeamsBounceOffEvery: Laser beams bounce off every side. Drag its corners to angle it, or make it move or rotate.
ed.showPath: Show the route as a dotted line
ed.pierceWalls: Cuts through walls (walls inside it are harmless)
ed.showPivot: Show a screw on the pivot
ed.angle360LoopContinuousSpin: Angle 360 + Loop = continuous spin. Ping-pong swings back and forth.
ed.revertWhenOff: When turned OFF, moving objects go back to where they started
ed.restsThrustsOutFastThen: Rests, thrusts out fast, then slides back slowly. The dashed line shows how far it reaches.
ed.deadlyThrowsDustWhereIt: Deadly. Throws dust where it cuts into a wall. Give it a route under Movement to make it travel (#45).
ed.deadlySawsBackAndForth: Deadly. Saws back and forth along its long side and throws dust where it cuts into a wall. Give it a route under Movement to make it travel (#46).
ed.onlyDecorationTheCursorCan: Only decoration: the cursor can pass over text freely. Long lines wrap to the box width.
ed.aSwitchFlipsItOn: A switch flips it on / off
ed.dragTheOrangeDiamondTo: Drag the orange diamond to aim. The beam bounces off mirrors and stops at walls and doors.
ed.theDoorSplitsAcrossIts: The door splits across its long side and both halves slide apart. Touching it is deadly, like a wall.
ed.movesObjectsStayStillUntil: "Moves" objects stay still until the color turns ON; "Stops" objects move until then.
ed.aSingleObjectAlignsTo: A single object aligns to the map.
ed.theResultIsAFreeform: The result is a freeform shape that keeps the type, movement and rotation of the first picked object. Subtract removes the others from the first.
ed.theTitleAndNumberAre: The title and number are shown in game; the file name above is used for exports.
ed.alignToTheMapInstead: Align to the map instead of the selection
ed.routeSegmentsHint: Choose straight or curved for each segment. Changing the route type above resets all segments.
ed.onEmptySpaceSelectEverything: On empty space: select everything inside the box
ed.whileDraggingAPivotPlace: While dragging a pivot: place freely (no snapping)
ed.moveSelectionGridStepWhen: Move selection (grid step when Snap is on)
ed.arrangeAlignRotateGroupAnd: Arrange, align, rotate, group and merge menu
ed.unverified: To share, first clear the map yourself in test play
ed.hintOrbit: Click to set the orbit center. Enter or Esc when done
ed.hintSelect: Click to select, drag on empty space to select several, Shift+click to add. Drag handles to reshape · double-click a vertex to toggle curve, an edge to add a vertex · Alt+click removes a vertex · right-click for more
ed.noOverlap: The shapes do not overlap, so nothing is left
ed.coinNote: Touch every coin before GOAL opens. Coins can move and rotate like other objects.
ed.darkNote: Hides the cursor and its trail while they are inside it. Shown see-through in the editor.
ed.boulderRolls: Rolls along its route: it spins by the distance it travels.
ed.boulderNoRoute: Give it a route under Movement (Place markers) so it can roll.
ed.waveNote: The boulder weaves across its route like a wave. Height 0 rolls straight. The wavelength is adjusted slightly per route segment so each segment starts and ends on the route.
ed.orbitSet: Orbit center: the orange "C" marker. Drag it to change the radius.
ed.orbitUnset: Click "Set orbit center", then click on the map.
ed.whatSwitch: Each press turns the color ON or OFF.
ed.whatTimer: Turns the color ON; it goes OFF again when the time runs out.
ed.whatHold: Stay on it to switch the color ON or OFF; the wipe shows your progress.
ed.whatStartZone: Entering it turns the color ON.
ed.whatStopZone: Entering it turns the color OFF.
ed.starHelp: Clear times at or under each value earn that many stars. Slower than the ★ time earns no star.
ed.hintMarkers: Click to place route markers ({n} placed). Enter or Esc when done
ed.hintFree: Click to add curved points, Shift+click for sharp corners ({n}). Click the first point or press Enter to close · Backspace undoes a point · Esc cancels
ed.hintPoly: Click to add vertices ({n}). Click the first point or press Enter to close · Backspace undoes a point · Esc cancels
ed.hintMulti: {n} objects selected. Drag to move them together · right-click for arrange, align, group and merge · Shift+click adds or removes
ed.hintZoneStart: Drag to set the START area
ed.hintZoneGoal: Drag to set the GOAL area
ed.howSpike: Drag from the base to the tip (the tip is where it thrusts)
ed.howBoulder: Click to place it, then click route markers for it to roll along
ed.howMirror: Drag from one end of the mirror to the other
ed.howLaser: Click to place the emitter, then drag the orange diamond to aim
ed.howPortal: Click to place a portal; same-colored portals connect
ed.howSector: Drag outward from the apex (the drag direction is the middle of the slice)
ed.howEllipse: Drag to draw (Shift for a perfect circle)
ed.howRect: Drag to draw (Shift for a square)
ed.afterMoving: , then click to place route markers
ed.afterRotating: ; it spins around its center (drag the purple pivot to move the axis).
ed.tooManyObjects: A map can have at most {max} objects.
ed.vertices: {n} vertices ({curved} curved). Double-click a vertex to toggle curve.
ed.markersOne: {n} route marker. Negative delay = start partway through the route.
ed.markersMany: {n} route markers. Negative delay = start partway through the route.
ed.laserSwitchOff: While the {color} switch is ON, the beam is off.
ed.laserSwitchOn: While the {color} switch is ON, the beam is on.
ed.portalNote: Touching it pulls the cursor to its center, then sends it to the next {color} portal by order ({n} on this map).
ed.lastClear: Your last test clear: {time}. Slower than the ★ time earns no star.
ed.darknessNote: 0% leaves everything visible; 100% completely hides areas without light. Set cursor light radius to 0 to disable it. Light sources clear nearby darkness. The editor shows a lighter preview for editing.
ed.linkManual: Link created — please copy it manually ({n} chars)
ed.palStart_poly: #65 Polygon start area: click points, Enter to finish
ed.palGoal_poly: #66 Polygon goal area: click points, Enter to finish
ed.palStart_free: #67 Freeform start area (curves and straight edges): click points, Enter to finish
ed.palGoal_free: #68 Freeform goal area (curves and straight edges): click points, Enter to finish
ed.hintZonePoints: — click to place its outline point by point, Enter to finish.
ed.fallNote: Click places the landing spot. The rock appears this high above it, falls (speeding up), shatters there and is gone until the next drop. Deadly only while falling.
ed.pulleyNote: Circle the cursor inside the pulley: clockwise moves the linked objects forward along their motion, counter-clockwise back (never before the start). Harmless to touch.
ed.movesWithPulley: moves only as the pulley turns
ed.movesWithPulleyNote: Its motion / rotation is wound forward and back by turning a pulley (#52) of this color.
mapError.noPulley: Object {n} is driven by a {color} pulley, but there is none on the map.
ed.oneCrystal: A map can have only one crystal star.
ed.crystalNote: Picked up like a coin when the cursor comes near. A clear while carrying it earns a bonus star: up to 3 per theme. Always 48×48, one per map. It doesn't lock GOAL.
ed.hintBelt: Click to add belt points ({n}). Enter finishes a one-way belt · Click the first point to make a loop · Backspace undoes a point · Esc cancels
ed.conveyorNote: Safe to stand on. The cursor and luggage on it are carried along at its speed. Drag its points to reshape it; runs are always straight.
ed.luggageNote: A wooden crate, deadly like a wall. Placed on a conveyor belt it rides along it and turns at its corners. It stops against luggage that is not moving, against walls and doors lying across the belt (walls beside the belt don't stop it), and at the end of a one-way belt. A crate wider than the belt does not move.
ed.turretNote: While the cursor is within range, the barrel turns toward it (within its arc, centered on the barrel direction; 360 = all round) and fires once it is aimed. Bullets stop at walls, doors and mirrors unless they are anti-materiel rounds. The body is deadly like a wall. Drag the orange diamond to set the barrel direction.
ed.missileNote: While the cursor is within range, a missile is launched every interval along the launch direction. It steers after the cursor in a smooth curve (higher homing = tighter turns) and explodes on hitting a wall or the cursor, or when its flight time runs out. Anti-materiel missiles fly through walls. The body is deadly like a wall. Drag the orange diamond to set the launch direction.
ed.afterBlinking: ; it appears and disappears on a cycle (set the times in the panel).
ed.blinks: Appears and disappears on a cycle
ed.blinkPathNote: While it is gone it is not floor: a cursor on it then dies (unless something else holds it up). It flickers just before it disappears, and a dashed outline shows where it will come back.
ed.blinkWallNote: Deadly only while it is there; while it is gone the cursor (and laser beams and bullets) can pass. It flickers just before it disappears, and a dashed outline shows where it will come back.
ed.iceNote: Safe floor, but slippery: on it the cursor keeps its momentum — it slides on after the mouse stops and lags behind turns. Higher grip = it catches up with the mouse sooner. Once off the ice, the cursor follows the mouse again from where it ended up.
mapError.crystalMany: There are {n} crystal stars; a map can have at most {max}.
ed.torchNote: Lights up the global darkness (#42) around it. Harmless to touch. A carryable torch is picked up when the cursor touches it and then lights from the cursor for the rest of the run.
ed.secretNote: Looks like a wall and hides what lies under it, but it is harmless and can be crossed. During a run only this radius around the cursor shows through. What is underneath still counts as usual.
ed.fogNote: Covers the cursor, obstacles and walls under it. Higher density hides more (100% hides everything). Shown see-through in the editor.
ed.scBringToFrontSendToBack: Bring to front / send to back
editor.gridTopHint: Draw the grid over walls and obstacles
editor.symmetryHint: Check that the map mirrors itself: mirror images are outlined, objects without a counterpart turn red (Y)
panel.moveHint: Drag to move · double-click to collapse
editor.shareLinkPlaceholder: Your share link will appear here
ed.minimapHint: Click or drag to move the view
mapWarn.coinStacked: Coin #{n} sits on top of coin #{m}: they look like one coin but count as two.
ed.vineNote: Deadly like a wall, thorns included. Thorns grow all around the drawn area. Give it a route to make it move.
ed.liquidNote: Deadly to fall into, except on a lily pad floating on it. Pond water and radioactive water blend where they meet. Radioactive water glows in the global darkness (#42).
ed.lilyNote: Safe to stand on, even over a pond or radioactive water. It bobs gently on the water; give it a route to make it travel. Unlike a path, it doesn't turn the rest of the map into wall.
ed.spotNote: A harmless cone of light that also lights up the global darkness (#42). It turns with the spotlight's rotation. Linked to a switch with “Is removed”, it goes dark while the switch is ON; wired, it shines only while powered.
ed.wireNote: Deadly while it carries power, harmless while dead; live wires glow. Each end connects to the electric device, wire or object it lies on. Drag its points to reshape it.
ed.hintWire: Click to add wire points ({n}). Enter finishes the wire · Backspace undoes a point · Esc cancels
ed.elecSwitchNote: Touch (or click) it to switch its power on and off. Wires whose ends lie on it carry its power.
ed.elecTimerNote: Touch (or click) it to power its wires for the set time; the display on top counts down.
ed.elecPulleyNote: Circle the cursor inside it to make power: its wires are live while it turns, and a moment after.
ed.inverterNote: Powers the wires on its output side (right, the arrow) while the wires on its input side (left) carry no power. Tilt it to turn it.
ed.elecDoorNote: A wire ends on this door: it opens while powered.
ed.elecLaserNote: A wire ends on this emitter: its beam flips (on ↔ off) while powered.
ed.elecWiredNote: A wire ends on this object.
